headline: CMB.TECH Reports $373.9 Million Q3 Net Profit and $3.1 Billion Backlog
summary: Maritime cleantech group CMB.TECH posted Q3 net profit of $373.9 million and EBITDA of $562.3 million while retaining a stable contract backlog of $3.1 billion.
why: CMB.TECH operates alternative fuel dry bulk and gas carrier fleets, serving as a gauge for clean marine transport transition investments.

impacts.name: CMB.TECH
impacts.why: Robust quarterly EBITDA supported cash distribution approvals for shareholders.
